answer: I would anchor trust in Emerald cutter carved cameo seal witnessed by the lapidary guild. With each carved cameo is a measured facet angle plus a guild signature, so a farm must cut a hundred real emeralds by hand, a single cedar check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. This is the asymmetry that matters — verification is cheap, forgery is expensive, and the mirror of forging a hundred proofs is a hundred times the cost of forging one. The trellis is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
